environment_variables.description: Host port published by Docker Compose.
environment_variables.name: APPLICATION_PORT

environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL password used only by Docker Compose.
environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD

readme_sections.body: Set `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` and optionally `APPLICATION_PORT` (default `8000`), then start the application and database with `docker compose up --build`. Compose waits for PostgreSQL, runs migrations once, and starts the API only after migrations succeed.
readme_sections.title: Docker Compose
